BackstoryDef.title: Wasteland Orphan
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] lost whatever family [PAWN_pronoun] started with somewhere along the way, and learned not to trust anyone who couldn't explain where they'd come from. It made [PAWN_objective] hard to fool and harder to approach.

BackstoryDef.title: Forger's Apprentice
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] learned to copy a signature, age a piece of paper, and talk past a checkpoint guard before [PAWN_pronoun] learned much else. A good forgery got people through gates that a good argument never would.

BackstoryDef.title: Signal Runner
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up chasing radio static across dead frequencies, hunting for the handful of channels still worth listening to. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to read meaning into silence long before anyone explained why that mattered.

BackstoryDef.title: Safehouse Kid
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in and out of houses that changed owners every few months, surrounded by neighbors who never asked questions. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to pack fast and to forget addresses on purpose.

BackstoryDef.title: Wasteland Scout
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood mapping safe routes between settlements, trading that knowledge for food and favors. [PAWN_pronoun] still thinks in terms of sightlines and exits.

BackstoryDef.title: Smuggler's Runner
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] moved packages nobody was supposed to ask about, learning which checkpoints could be bought and which had to be avoided outright.

BackstoryDef.title: Rooftop Watcher
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood watching streets from rooftops and fire escapes, learning to spot a patrol pattern before it spotted [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: Stray Sympathizer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] fed and hid stray dogs long before [PAWN_pronoun] ever hid a person, and never saw much difference between the two kinds of loyalty.

BackstoryDef.title: Aid Station Helper
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] helped out at a traveling aid station, learning to set a splint and keep a straight face around wounds that would have put most kids off medicine for good.

BackstoryDef.title: Scrap Rigger
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] took apart everything that exploded and most things that didn't, building crude charges out of scrap long before anyone taught [PAWN_objective] how to do it properly.

BackstoryDef.title: Tunnel Rat
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up mapping the drains and service tunnels under the old cities, memorizing routes that didn't show up on any surface map.

BackstoryDef.title: Skeptical Kid
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] learned to read a lie off someone's face before [PAWN_pronoun] learned much else worth knowing, a habit that made [PAWN_objective] difficult to fool and worse to grow up around.

BackstoryDef.title: Gunsmith's Helper
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] apprenticed under a wasteland gunsmith, learning to strip, clean, and rebuild a weapon well before [PAWN_pronoun] was old enough to be trusted firing one.

BackstoryDef.title: Chameleon Kid
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] could talk [PAWN_possessive] way into or out of nearly anything by the time [PAWN_pronoun] was old enough to lie convincingly, and rarely needed to use the same story twice.

BackstoryDef.title: Purge Survivor
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] survived a raid that nobody else in [PAWN_possessive] cell did, and came out of it with a permanent, well-earned reluctance to trust a plan just because it sounded solid.

BackstoryDef.title: Message Runner
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] carried messages for anyone who'd pay in caps or food, learning routes and hiding spots across half the wasteland before [PAWN_pronoun] hit [PAWN_possessive] teens.

BackstoryDef.title: Field Agent
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] runs operations for the Railroad under a name that isn't [PAWN_possessive] own, moving between safehouses and dead drops with the practiced calm of someone who has been questioned before and given nothing away.

BackstoryDef.title: Document Forger
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] builds the paper trails that let a synth walk past a checkpoint as somebody who was always human. Every identity [PAWN_pronoun] manufactures has to survive a closer look than the last one.

BackstoryDef.title: Signal Operator
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] runs the Railroad's coded broadcasts, packing extraction routes and warnings into transmissions that sound like static to anyone not listening for them.

BackstoryDef.title: Safehouse Keeper
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] keeps a safehouse running, feeding and hiding whoever the Railroad sends through until it's safe to move them again. [PAWN_pronoun] has learned exactly how long is too long to keep anyone in one place.

BackstoryDef.title: Railroad Recruiter
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] finds the people worth trusting with the Railroad's secrets, and just as often finds the ones who'd sell them out for the right price. [PAWN_pronoun] has been wrong exactly once, and doesn't plan on a second time.

BackstoryDef.title: Railroad Smuggler
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] moves weapons, medicine, and people past checkpoints that were never meant to let any of it through. Every route [PAWN_pronoun] uses is already half-compromised by the time anyone else finds out about it.

BackstoryDef.title: Railroad Lookout
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] holds a rifle and a sightline for hours at a stretch, watching for coursers so the rest of the safehouse doesn't have to.

BackstoryDef.title: Synth Escort
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] walks liberated synths the last leg of the route personally, past the checkpoints where a nervous escort has gotten people killed before.

BackstoryDef.title: Field Medic
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] patches up whoever the Railroad sends through, no questions about how they got hurt and none about what they used to be.

BackstoryDef.title: Railroad Demolitionist
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] clears the way when a route gets blocked and covers the retreat when one collapses on purpose. [PAWN_pronoun] doesn't build anything [PAWN_pronoun] isn't prepared to set off early.

BackstoryDef.title: Route Planner
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] plots the paths that move people and cargo without crossing a single checkpoint, redrawing the map every time one of those routes gets burned.

BackstoryDef.title: Vetting Specialist
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] interviews every new contact the Railroad brings in, hunting for the tell that separates a genuine sympathizer from a courser wearing one's face.

BackstoryDef.title: Railroad Armorer
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] keeps the Railroad's scavenged arsenal running, rebuilding weapons that were written off as scrap by everyone except [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: Deep Cover Operative
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has worn more names than [PAWN_pronoun] can list, embedding inside settlements and caravans for months at a time to watch for Institute activity nobody else can get close enough to see.

BackstoryDef.title: Old Guard Veteran
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] has outlived most of the agents [PAWN_pronoun] trained with, and treats every new recruit as someone [PAWN_pronoun] hasn't finished worrying about yet.

BackstoryDef.title: Route Runner
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] carries cargo and messages between safehouses that don't trust radios, memorizing routes and burning them the moment they stop being safe.
